# xcode-project

SwiftPM build output, CocoaPods pods and Carthage dependencies inside a project.

**Name:** Swift and CocoaPods project build · **Category:** Project artifacts · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

## In projects

| Folder | Only when | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `.build` | next to `Package.swift` | Safe; Review if the project was used recently | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `quarantine` |
| `Pods` | next to `Podfile` | Review; Review if the project was used recently | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `quarantine` |
| `Carthage` | next to `Cartfile` or `Cartfile.resolved` | Review; Review if the project was used recently | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `quarantine` |

To get it back: `swift build`, `pod install`, `carthage bootstrap`.
